title: Lux
subtitle: Light, in the old tongue
text: Lux — light, in the alchemical tongue. The ancient name for the Incandescent tendency. Blood shaped by lux does not hide itself. It expands. It illuminates. It travels in all directions at once because containment is a concept foreign to it. The earliest records of lux-tended Hemomancers describe them as difficult to look at directly — not metaphorically. The blood had become so saturated with outward force that it simply glowed.
